mechanism_narrative: Sustained low FEDFUNDS signals easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE rising above 0.3% triggers positive 5-day returns as higher labor participation signals expanding labor market and market optimism, boosting equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive despite UNRATE crossing 0.3pp threshold in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, persistent FEDFUNDS below 0.2% signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering borrowing costs and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns not significantly higher than average late-cycle period (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS staying below 0.2.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of FEDFUNDS remaining below 0.2% (monetary easing) and GDPC1 (demand) rising above 13,194.9 signals strong demand and loose policy, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate sustained growth.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive despite both proxies meeting trigger conditions in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 2.0% triggers negative 5-day returns as high inflation erodes corporate profit margins and investor confidence, pressuring equity valuations downward.
